tone: pastoral, exhortational, polemical, Christ-centered, participatory, and triumphant
target_reader: religion-naive adults and older adolescents near grade 6
translation_identity: firmly dynamic-equivalence, NLT-like in readability but independent
test_purpose: Human Editor-approved source-side Passage-Sense Resolution packet for blind A/B/C drafting of Colossians 2:6-15.

sealed_context.instruction: Use only the SBLGNT Greek, this approved source-side sense brief, and the unit-scoped Matrix alerts. Comparison translations, prior FLT English, conversational drafts, and editor benchmarks are forbidden from blind-worker input.

copyright_advisory.instruction: Run string-spotting only after all independent candidates exist. Surface hits in the Decision Brief. A constrained-phrase exception may be proposed when at least three comparison translations converge on wording forced by the Greek; comparison wording is never drafting input.

governing_rules: Preserve the as-you-received-Him / so-live-in-Him correspondence of Col.2.6.
Preserve the deliberate mixed agricultural and architectural metaphors and aspect contrast in Col.2.7.
Do not condemn philosophy as an intellectual discipline in general; Paul's target is the deceptive teaching described here.
Render stoicheia with deliberately underdetermined source-side guidance: the elemental principles that govern this world. Do not resolve it as spirit powers or basic teachings.

Preserve the rhetorical relation between pleroma in 2.9 and pepleromenoi in 2.10. The latter is perfect passive and describes a settled state already brought about, never an aspiration or progressive process.
Keep somatikos bodily/incarnational as the primary source-side force while acknowledging that its precise range is contested.
Do not make the circumcision of Christ sound like Jesus' infant circumcision; source-side sense is circumcision effected by or in union with Christ.
In Col.2.11 preserve the physical-body force and the Col.1.22 echo of to soma tes sarkos; sinful nature is forbidden there.
The buried-with / raised-with / made-alive-with Christ element in Col.2.12-13 is load-bearing and must remain audible throughout.
At Col.2.12 the faith-genitive is contested. Objective faith in God's working is the working ruling, not a settled claim; a Transparency Note is required.
Hold one working subject consistently through Col.2.13-15. God is the working construal; mid-sentence drift between God and Christ is a blocking defect.
At Col.2.14 do not identify cheirographon with the Mosaic law as a whole. The bare dative tois dogmasin remains syntactically unresolved; wording must survive both live relations.

At Col.2.15 preserve public victorious triumph without requiring the phrase triumphal procession. En auto is contested; through the cross is the low-confidence working ruling because of v14 proximity.
Carry applicable prior Colossians lexical precedents forward only within their approved scopes. The pler- family remains without a corpus-level English policy; flag the gap rather than inventing one.

matrix_alerts.guidance: Christ Himself remains the object; apostolic-reception resonance is secondary. Preserve the as...so correspondence with living in Him.
Perfect passive: completed rooting with continuing state; preserve agricultural image.
Present passive: ongoing being-built-up process; preserve architectural image and mixed metaphor.
2.7 faith/trust according to taught message; 2.12 genitive is contested, with faith in God's working as the low-margin working ruling; do not present the latter as settled.
Context-specific deceptive philosophy/teaching, not a blanket condemnation of philosophy.
Captivity/spoil metaphor should remain perceptible if natural English permits.

matrix_alerts.approved_rendering_guidance: the elemental principles that govern this world

matrix_alerts.guidance: All fullness of deity in Christ; preserve the lexical/rhetorical handoff to pepleromenoi in v10 if natural English permits. No corpus-level pler- policy exists yet.
pepleromenoi is perfect passive: a settled state already brought about in Christ; never aspirational or progressive. Preserve relation to pleroma v9.
Full deity / what belongs to being God; do not weaken the Christological claim.
Bodily/incarnational sense primary, exact range contested; do not overstate certainty.
Christ is head over every ruler and authority; preserve supremacy without importing a new corpus-wide head metaphor policy.
Maintain continuity with Col.1.16 cosmic rulers/authorities language unless English context requires a justified variation.
Non-handmade Christ-related circumcision effected by/in union with Christ; do not imply Jesus' infant circumcision.
Not made/done by human hands; distinguishes this circumcision from ordinary physical circumcision.
Preserve physical-body force in to soma tes sarkos; the prior Col.1.22 rendering his own physical body is a literary echo.
2.11 physical-body force; sinful nature is forbidden. 2.13 uncircumcision-of-your-flesh context remains physical/covenantal rather than a license for a generic sinful-nature gloss.
Stripping/removal in v11 and stripping/disarming in v15; preserve a family echo if possible without distortion.
Buried with Christ / raised with Christ / made alive with Christ. The with-Christ element must be audible in all three and may not be dropped for style.
Forgiveness is primary with grace-gift coloring available where natural.
Written record of indebtedness/obligation standing against us; do not equate directly with the Mosaic law.
Bare dative relation to cheirographon unresolved: consisting of decrees or against us by means of them. Wording must survive either construal.
Erase/wipe out/cancel the hostile written record; preserve written-record imagery if possible.
Public victorious triumph over defeated powers; Roman-triumph background belongs to source rationale but triumphal procession is not mandatory reading-text wording.

verses.greek: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε,
ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.
Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν·
ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς θεότητος σωματικῶς,
καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας,
ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτισμῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν·
καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ· χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα,
ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ·
ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ, θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ.

passage_argument: As the believers received Christ Jesus the Lord, so they must continue living in Him; v7 develops that life through completed rooting, ongoing building, strengthening in the taught faith, and overflowing thanksgiving.
The danger in v8 is capture by empty deceptive teaching sourced in human tradition and the deliberately underdetermined elemental principles that govern this world rather than Christ.

Verses 9-10 ground the warning in Christ's sufficiency: all the fullness of deity dwells bodily in Him, and the believers already stand in a settled cognate fullness/completeness in Him, who is head over every ruler and authority.
Verses 11-13 describe Christ-related circumcision and a load-bearing with-Christ participation chain: buried with Him, raised with Him, and made alive with Him.

Verses 13-15 continue with one working divine subject: God forgives, erases/removes the hostile written record, and publicly defeats the rulers and authorities; the precise antecedent of en auto remains contested.

proposition_map.proposition: As they received Christ Jesus the Lord, so they are to continue living in Him, already rooted, continually built up, strengthened in the taught faith, and overflowing with thanksgiving.

They must not be carried off by empty deceptive teaching grounded in human tradition and the elemental principles that govern this world rather than Christ; the precise ontology of the stoicheia remains deliberately unresolved.
All the fullness of deity dwells bodily in Christ; the believers already stand in a settled cognate state in Him, and He is head over every ruler and authority.

In Christ they received a non-human circumcision involving removal of the physical body/fleshly body, were buried with Christ in baptism, and were raised with Him through faith in God's working; the faith-genitive remains contested.

Though dead in transgressions and uncircumcision, God made them alive with Christ, forgave transgressions, erased the hostile written record, removed it, and nailed it to the cross without requiring a settled syntactic construal of the dative decrees.

Continuing the one-subject working construal, God stripped/disarmed rulers and authorities, exposed them publicly, and triumphed over them; through the cross is the low-confidence working reading of en auto, not a settled antecedent.

expressions.contextual_function: grounds present conduct in their prior reception of Christ
expressions.primary_sense: As they received Christ Himself through the apostolic proclamation, so they must continue living in Him.
expressions.discourse_evidence: The personal object is Christ Jesus the Lord and the second half commands life in Him.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Make the as...so correspondence audible; do not render the halves as unrelated statements.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: No required reader note unless English obscures reception/tradition resonance.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not replace Christ Himself with merely receiving teaching.

expressions.contextual_function: describes the shape of continuing life in Christ
expressions.primary_sense: Already rooted; continually being built up; being strengthened; overflowing with thanksgiving.
expressions.discourse_evidence: Perfect then present participles and deliberately mixed plant/building imagery.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Preserve aspect contrast and mixed metaphors; preserve the teaching/reception link of καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε back to v6.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not flatten both metaphors into generic growth or erase completed-versus-ongoing contrast.

expressions.contextual_function: names a non-Christ source/order behind the deceptive teaching
expressions.primary_sense: the elemental principles that govern this world
expressions.discourse_evidence: Col.2.20 connects the term with regulations, while vv10 and 15 use different vocabulary for rulers/authorities; evidence does not warrant collapsing the ambiguity.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Use deliberately underdetermined English; forbidden resolutions are spirit powers and basic teachings.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: [tn] required: explain both live readings without choosing one as certain.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not resolve the ontology beyond the evidence.

expressions.contextual_function: grounds believers' sufficiency in Christ's divine fullness
expressions.primary_sense: All divine fullness dwells in Christ; believers already possess a settled cognate fullness/completeness in Him.
expressions.discourse_evidence: Cognate wording links vv9-10; pepleromenoi is perfect passive.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Keep the handoff audible if natural English permits; v10 must sound settled/already accomplished, never aspirational or progressive.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: Flag that FLT still lacks a corpus-level pler- family English policy.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not imply believers become divine; do not say can become complete or are being filled.

expressions.contextual_function: qualifies how the fullness of deity dwells in Christ
expressions.discourse_evidence: The word is a hapax and the incarnational sense is primary, but its precise nuance is contested.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Preserve bodily force but do not present a disputed finer nuance as certain.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: A transparency note may acknowledge the range if the reading text makes a strong interpretive choice.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not reduce it to merely really/fully with no bodily content.

expressions.contextual_function: describes a non-human Christ-related circumcision of believers
expressions.primary_sense: circumcision effected by/in union with Christ
expressions.discourse_evidence: The believers are the ones circumcised; it is not made by hands and leads into burial/resurrection with Christ.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Do not allow English that naturally sounds like Jesus' infant circumcision.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: [tn] recommended for the genitive and metaphor.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not over-specify a ritual mechanism not stated by the text.

expressions.contextual_function: names what is stripped off in the circumcision metaphor
expressions.primary_sense: physical body/fleshly body with an intentional literary echo to Col.1.22
expressions.discourse_evidence: Same construction previously rendered in Col.1.22 with physical-body force.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Preserve physical-body force. Sinful nature is forbidden.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: No note required solely for this lock unless the metaphor needs explanation.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not insert a theological sinful-nature gloss or sever the Col.1.22 echo.

expressions.source_expression: διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ
expressions.contextual_function: relates faith and God's raising work
expressions.primary_sense: faith in God's working (working ruling, marginal confidence)
expressions.discourse_evidence: Objective reading is marginally favored by word order, but no English construction naturally preserves both genitive relations.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Use the objective reading only as a working rendering; do not present the question as settled.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not suppress the live alternative.

expressions.contextual_function: forms the participatory backbone of the paragraph
expressions.primary_sense: buried with Christ, raised with Christ, made alive with Christ
expressions.discourse_evidence: The repeated syn- compounds explicitly mark participation with Christ.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: The with-Christ element must be audible in all three and may not be varied away for style.
expressions.choice_risks: Dropping the with-Christ element in any member is a blocking semantic loss.

expressions.contextual_function: maintains coherent agency through the long sentence
expressions.primary_sense: God is the working subject throughout the chain
viable_alternatives: Christ as subject at some point in the chain
expressions.discourse_evidence: God is explicit in v12 and is the working subject of made-alive; the following chain is syntactically and referentially dense.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Choose one subject consistently through the sentence. God is the working construal. Mid-sentence drift between God and Christ is a blocking defect.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: Source-aware apparatus may flag the subject construal as not certain.

expressions.source_expression: τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν
expressions.contextual_function: pictures a hostile written obligation/record removed at the cross
expressions.primary_sense: a written record of indebtedness/obligation standing against us
viable_alternatives: record standing against us by means of decrees
expressions.discourse_evidence: The record is against us, erased, removed, and nailed to the cross; tois dogmasin is a bare dative.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Do not identify the record directly with the Mosaic law. Use wording that survives either live dative relation.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: [tn] recommended if the reading text necessarily selects a syntactic relation.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not confidently smooth the bare dative into a disputed construction.

expressions.contextual_function: climaxes the unit with public defeat of hostile powers
expressions.primary_sense: public victorious triumph; through the cross is the low-confidence working reading of en auto
viable_alternatives: in/through Christ as antecedent of en auto
expressions.discourse_evidence: Roman-triumph imagery is present; v14's immediately preceding cross favors cross/it, but the broader antecedent chain is tangled.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Preserve public victory; do not require the technical phrase triumphal procession. If using through the cross, do so as a low-confidence working decision rather than pretending certainty.
expressions.literal_note_guidance: [tn] recommended for Roman-triumph background and antecedent alternative if compressed.
expressions.choice_risks: Do not erase the victory image or present en auto as settled.
